talk.jaymoskingdoms.disarmed.3: Curse it, where did it go?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.respec: I can unmake what you've learned, so you may learn again. It'll cost you %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.scholar.0: A visitor! I raised this island to watch the stars, and I've not managed to bring it down since. Here, for your trouble.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.scholar.1: Mind the edge. I'm a scholar, stuck up here by my own spell. Take a scroll for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.scholar.2: Oh! Nobody comes up here. I study the sky, and the sky is very close. Have this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.retreat.0: You found my retreat. I left the courts for some peace up here. Take this, and don't tell the kings.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.retreat.1: A guest, at this height? I came up here to get away from kingdoms. A scroll, for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.retreat.2: Quiet up here, isn't it? That's why I stay. Here, something for your trouble.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.warden.0: Careful where you step. I'm the warden of this island; my spell keeps it in the sky. Take this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.warden.1: Welcome, traveller. Without me this rock would fall. A scroll, for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.warden.2: You climbed all this way? Then you've earned this. I keep the island up; you keep your footing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.exile.0: I was a court wizard, once. Banished up here. It's good to see a face. Have this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.exile.1: The king sent me as far from the ground as he could. You found me anyway. A scroll, for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.exile.2: An exile's hospitality isn't much, but take this. I've plenty of time to write them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.pardon.prompt: You only half caught what %s said.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.0.more: Nothing you can't manage, I'd wager. Right-click me and I'll show you what needs doing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.1.more: Honest work, honest pay. Right-click me and see what I've got.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.2.more: I've asked everyone in the village and nobody will. Please, just right-click me and look.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.0.more: The errand I gave you. Bring me what I asked and you'll be paid, as promised.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.1.more: You've still got the job I gave you. Check your journal (M) if you've forgotten.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.2.more: My errand, remember? If it's done, right-click me and we'll settle up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.0.more: Things went missing, and you were seen. Own up and pay a fine and we'll say no more of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.1.more: Something was taken, or broken, and folk say it was you. Pay up and it's forgotten. Lie and it's worse.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.2.more: You did a wrong here, stranger. Confess and pay and the matter's closed. Walk away and everyone will know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.0.more: We've had thieves and worse through %s. I'll only ask once: are you here to trade, to work, or something else?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.1.more: No offence meant. Every stranger in %s gets asked. Trade, work, or trouble?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.2.more: It's my job to know who walks the streets of %s. Tell me why you've come and you can go on your way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.0.more: Anything at all would do. Bread, a potato, whatever you can spare.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.1.more: The stores ran low and my family comes first. Just one bite of something, if you have it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.2.more: I'm not begging, you understand. Well, I am. Any food you've got.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.0.more: %1$s %2$s, yours for %3$s. You'll pay more at any stall, I promise you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.1.more: I made too much, see, and it'll only go to waste. %1$s %2$s for %3$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.2.more: Good work, fair price: %1$s %2$s for %3$s. Today only, mind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.0.more: It's a thank-you, for being a good friend to us. Keep it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.1.more: I've had it for days, waiting for you to pass. It's in your pack now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.2.more: It's nothing, really, just something I thought you'd like. Check your pack.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.0.more: %s marched on us, or we on them, it hardly matters now. Stand with us and we'll remember it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.1.more: The war with %s goes badly. Every blade helps. Say you'll stand with us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.greet.0.more: We were only talking about you, %s. Stay a while, if you've time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.greet.1.more: You've done right by us, %s. There's always a welcome here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.greet.2.more: It's been too long, %s. Come and see us more often.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.0.more: Zombies, skeletons, worse. They come out once the sun's down. A bed and a door, that's what you want.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.1.more: Stay where the torches are. Whatever's out there doesn't like the light.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.2.more: Hissing in the dark, just past the fields. Keep your back to a wall.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.0.more: Tag! You chase me and I run! You're it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.1.more: A knight! With a shiny helmet and everything! Are you? Are you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.2.more: Your sword! I want to see it up close. Please please please?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.command.nobody: Nobody nearby could come over about that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.0: You there! You look like you can handle yourself. I could use a hand.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.1: Excuse me, traveller! I have work, if you want it, and I pay fair.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.2: Oh, thank goodness, a capable face. Would you hear me out? I need help.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.0: Well? How goes the task I set you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.1: Any news on what I asked of you? Come, tell me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.2: There you are! I was hoping to see you. Have you done it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.0: I know your face. Word is you were the one in our stores. Was it you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.1: Hold on. People are talking about you, and none of it good. Explain yourself.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.2: You! Somebody saw what you did here. What have you to say for it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.answer.confes: It was me. I'll pay for it (%s)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.answer.deny: It wasn't me, I swear it
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.answer.threat: Keep talking and see what happens
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.reply.confess: Honest, at least. Mind it doesn't happen again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.reply.believe: Hm. Maybe I had the wrong of it. My apologies.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.reply.liar: Liar. I'll be telling the others about you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.reply.threate: Help! Guards! This one's threatening me!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.ignored: Walking away, are we? I knew it was you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.0: Halt, stranger. What's your business in %s?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.1: You there, hold a moment. State your business in %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.2: Easy, traveller. Not many strangers come through %s. Why are you here?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.reply.trade: Fair enough. Keep the peace and you'll have no trouble from me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.reply.work: Work? Try %s, over that way. They were looking for help.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.reply.no_work: Nobody's hiring that I know of. Ask about the village, someone may have something.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.reply.rude: Watch your tongue, stranger. I'll have my eye on you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.ignored: Hey! I'm talking to you! ...I'll remember that face.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.0: Could you spare a bite to eat? The harvest's been thin this season.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.1: Sorry to trouble you, but I haven't eaten since yesterday. Have you any food?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.2: Spare a crust for a hungry neighbour? I'd be ever so grateful.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.reply.fed: Bless you! I won't forget this kindness.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.reply.refused: I understand. Times are hard for everyone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.0: Fancy a bargain? I can let you have %s %s for %s. Better than the market!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.1: Psst, friend. I've %s %s going spare. Yours for %s?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.2: You look like someone who knows quality. %s %s, %s, today only.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.reply.refuse: Your loss! Come find me if you change your mind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.0: I made this for you. It's not much, but I wanted you to have it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.1: Here, I saved this for you. Don't say I never gave you anything!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.2: Oh, it's you! I was hoping I'd see you. Take this, please.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.0: They say we're at war with %s. Will you stand with us?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.1: Have you heard? It's war with %s. We need every arm we can get. Are you with us?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.reply.stand: Then the gods go with you, friend!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.reply.refuse: Then keep out of the way when the fighting comes.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.greet.0: %s! Good to see you again, friend!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.greet.2: Well, if it isn't %s! How have you been?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.0: It's getting dark, traveller. Get indoors before the dead start walking.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.1: Night's falling. Don't wander far from the lights, the monsters are about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.2: Stay close to the village tonight. I've heard the creepers out there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.0.yes: Ready or not, here I come!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.1: Whoa, is that real armour? Are you a knight?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.1.reply: I'm going to be a knight too when I grow up!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.2: Is that a real sword? Can I see it? Please?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.2.reply: Wooow. I bet you've slain a hundred monsters with that!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.writ: You've learned nothing I could unmake. But I have a Writ of Rebirth, if you'd be someone else entirely: %s silver.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.writ.sold: %s has no writ for you this week; the ink takes time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.writ.done: Read it when you're ready. There's no reading it twice.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.staff: A Mage without a staff? I can tell you how one is made. And I have a Writ of Rebirth, if you'd be someone else entirely: %s silver.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.staff.done: Gold and amethyst, bound to two rods of blaze. Mind your fingers.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.alien.seen: Saints preserve us... that thing is you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.trespass.warn.0: What are you doing in my house?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.trespass.warn.1: I don't know you. Why are you in my home?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.trespass.warn.2: Don't touch anything. I'm watching you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tag.caught: Aww, you got me! I'm it! One... two... three...
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tag.done: Phew! I'm all tired out. That was the best game ever!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tag.done.slow: You never caught me! I'm the fastest in the whole village!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tag.bedtime: Uh oh, it's getting dark. Mum's calling me! Bye!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.symbiote.seen: It just... swallowed them? And they're still in there?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shade.seen: They died... and got up as a shadow of themselves. I need to sit down.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.1: %s's eyes! Look at their eyes, they're red!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.3: That's not %s, not any more! Bar the doors!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.4: %s's got teeth like a wolf! Get inside!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.5: It was %s all along! It was them the whole time!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.7: Don't let %s bite you! Don't let them near!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.8: I knew %s never ate supper with us. I knew it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.10: %s just bit someone! I saw it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.one.1: Did you know there's a %2$s living among us? Keeps to themselves, mostly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.one.2: We've a %2$s in town now. The children won't stop staring.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.one.3: That %2$s down the lane? Kind enough. Strange ways, though.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.one.4: Only one %2$s here, and everyone has an opinion about them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.many.1: There are %3$s %2$s living here now. It's not the place it was, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.many.2: %3$s of the %2$s, right here among us. They keep to their own.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.many.3: The %2$s are settling in. %3$s of them now, and more coming, I'd wager.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.mixed.1: Heartlanders, Earthlings, %2$s, even %3$s. Quite the mix we've become.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.mixed.2: A %2$s and a %3$s under the same banner. My grandmother wouldn't believe it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.mixed.3: Between the %2$s and the %3$s, the market's never been so loud.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.plain.1: Heartlanders and Earthlings, all of us here. Plain folk, and glad of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.plain.2: Never met anyone of the old bloods. Not round here, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.plain.3: They say there are Frostborn and Tideborn out in the wide world. Never seen one myself.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_body.shed.0: Won't go over the fins. Never does.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_body.shed.1: Smith swore it'd fit. Smiths always swear that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_body.shed.2: Plate's for the flat-backed. I'll keep to the water.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_body.shed.3: There. Off. I'd sooner be quick than buckled.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_body.shed.4: Keep it. Iron and me don't sit right together.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_body.bow.0: No helm fits this head. Give me a bow, then, and room to shoot.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_body.bow.1: Can't stand the line in plate, so I'll stand behind it with a bow.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_body.bow.2: Out of reach and out of the press. Suits me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sea_body.bow.3: The captain says archers and riders. I say fine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.downed.0: Stay down. Let's see who you are.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.downed.1: Not so fast, masked one. Off it comes.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.downed.2: Nobody touches them till I've seen that face.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.body.0: A body in a mask? Let's have a look at you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.body.1: Stand back, all of you. I want to see who this is.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.body.2: Somebody's going to have to name this one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.0: Halt, masked one. Nobody walks the streets of %s with their face hidden. Show yourself: lower that hood or take off the mask.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.1: You, in the hood and mask. The king trusts no face he can't see, and neither do I. Take it off.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.2: Stop right there. Masks are for assassins and thieves. Who are you, under that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.0.more: The king's sure someone means him harm, and a mask is just the way they'd come. Unmask, let me search you, or leave %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.1.more: I've my orders. Every masked stranger in %s shows their face or turns out their pack. Or goes.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.2.more: Nobody hides their face in %s unless they've reason to. Show me yours, or show me your pack, or get out.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.answer.lift: Lift your mask (or lower your hood) for him
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.answer.search: Keep your face hidden, but let him search you
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.reply.lift: %s. Hm. Put it back on if you must. I'll know you now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.reply.lift_tr: %s! I knew that face. Guards! Seize them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.reply.search_: Nothing. Fine, go on. But I'll be watching that mask.
And what's this? Stolen goods! That's a fine of %s, and you're coming with me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.reply.refuse: Then you've no business in %s. Out, before I count to thirty, or we'll drag you out.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.horns: %s Hornkin horns! Well done. Here are %s, as I promised anyone who drives those raiders off.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.notice.posting.0: There. "%s". Someone ought to read it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.posting.0: Wanted: %s! %s to whoever brings them in.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.posting.1: There. %s, %s. Someone ought to see to it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.posting.2: Another one for the board: %s, worth %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.bandit.1: Masked and armed... bandit! Somebody fetch the guard!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.bandit.2: Bandit in the square! Hide the silver!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.bandit.3: I don't like the look of that one. Bandit, mark me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.bandit.4: Keep your face covered, do you? Honest folk don't.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.pirate.1: A sea-thief, bold as brass! Lock the stores!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.pirate.2: That's a pirate's rag on that face, I'd swear it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.pirate.4: Off your ship and into our town, are you? Pirate!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.alive.0: %s, alive and in chains. Well done. Here: %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.alive.1: So this is %s. Not so bold now. Your %s, hunter.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.alive.2: The crown keeps its word: %s brought in, %s paid.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.head.0: The head of %s. Grim work, but it's done. %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.head.1: I'd rather have had %s alive. Still: %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.head.2: Put it on a spike by the gate. %s won't trouble us again. %s for you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.cells.1: Throw %s in the dungeon and lose the key.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.cells.2: %s will answer to the court. Away with them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.1.her: You, in the hood and mask. The queen trusts no face she can't see, and neither do I. Take it off.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.0.more.her: The queen's sure someone means her harm, and a mask is just the way they'd come. Unmask, let me search you, or leave %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orders.posting.0: Orders taken here! Pay up front, we'll send it on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orders.posting.2: Can't come to the stalls? Order from the board.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.ask: You look worn. What can I do for you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.heal_free: Mend my wounds and set my bones (free, for a friend of the realm)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.scroll_restor: A Scroll of Restoration (%s, one a week)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.healed_free: Hold still... there. The realm looks after its friends.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.sold: Read it when you need it most.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.sold_restorat: Few are given one of these. Don't waste it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.zfighter.nothing: They have nothing for you right now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.ashore: I'm a sailor, not a townsman. I've no work to give ashore.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.pirate.captain: Work? Aboard the %s you'd sign our articles and swab her decks for a share of what we take. Not today.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.pirate.hand: I'm her %s. The %s takes what she likes, and I get my share. Talk to the captain if you're brave.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.navy.captain: The %s sails for %s's navy. If you'd serve the crown at sea, take it up with the crown.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.navy.hand: I'm a %s aboard the %s. We keep the sea clear of pirates. The captain's the one to ask about anything else.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.merchant.captai: The %s carries %s's goods, bound for %s. No berths for passengers, but I'd pay well if pirates come at us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.merchant.hand: I'm her %s. The %s carries cargo, and I haul it. Ask the captain about where we're bound.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.refuse: I know what you are. I'll not lend my hands to your kind. Go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.suspect.wary.0: Keep your hands where I can see them, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.suspect.wary.1: Folk have been talking about you, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.suspect.wary.2: Something's not right about you, %1$s. I'm watching.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.guilty.vampir: Unclean! %1$s is one of the blood-drinkers! Seize them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.guilty.wolf: The water burns! %1$s carries the wolf's curse! Seize them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.wrong: Shame on you! %1$s is no more cursed than I am.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.none: You have read every chart I own. The rest I have only dreamt.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.short: Not enough coin. The sky is not free, but it is not dear either.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.known: You have that one already. Look up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.sold: There. The chart of %s. Read it under a clear sky and the light will be there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.hermit.0: I have watched this sky longer than I have watched anything. Some lights I can sell you the way to.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.hermit.1: Up here the stars are close enough to count. I have charts, if you can count too.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.hermit.2: A chart is only paper until you read it. Then it is a light that stays.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.hermit.3: Every chart I own was drawn by someone who went and came back. Mostly came back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.stargazer.0: Shh. Watch that one. It was not there last month.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.stargazer.1: I sit up most nights. The sky keeps changing its mind, and I like to be there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.stargazer.2: I trade in charts. A little paper, a little guessing, and a lot of staying up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.stargazer.3: Something moves between the fixed lights, if you wait for it. I have charts of where it goes.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.dust: Trade %2$s for %1$s pieces of Maw dust
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stars.dust_sold: Careful with it. It is what is left when a dead star is ground down, and it still remembers shining.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.rival.greet.0: %1$s, a student of %2$s, on our ground? State your business, and keep it short.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.rival.greet.1: We of %3$s have little time for those who follow %2$s. What do you want, %1$s?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.rival.greet.2: You wear the airs of %2$s, %1$s. Do try not to bring them into my watch.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.rival.sneer.0: Ha. A student of %2$s, here. Mind your stance.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.rival.sneer.1: %2$s, is it? Our novices could beat that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.rival.sneer.2: Look who walks through our gate, %1$s. Another of %2$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ogre_king.phase2.1: You bleed me? Come, all of you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ogre_king.phase3.0: I'll bury you under my hold!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.trial.passed.brawl: Strong little thing. King says you live.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.inbalm.varro.0: Something's burning on my brow... %1$s. I'll come when you call.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.inbalm.varro.1: I feel it. Your mark, %1$s. I'll go home. For now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.inbalm.varro.2: %1$s. I don't know what you did. I'll know your fight when I hear it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.inbalm.grimsby.0: A real blade? For me? I'll swing it where you say, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.inbalm.grimsby.1: My own won't know till it's too late, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.inbalm.grimsby.2: I'm your blade in their camp, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.inbalm.ambrose.0: I... I'm not angry anymore. I'll walk with you, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.inbalm.ambrose.2: Hrrm. %1$s. I go where you go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.inbalm.thessaly.1: Leave me be, %1$s. I'm going home.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.inbalm.thessaly.2: Get out of my eyes! ...What did you do, %1$s?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.treatment: A full treatment: bones set, cuts closed, every part healed (%s)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.treated: Lie still... bones set, cuts closed, all mended. A limb that is gone I cannot give back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.cot: Rest easy. I'll see to your bones and your wounds while you lie there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.plain.orc.0: Dat not money. Dat straight stick. Me want BENT.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.plain.orc.1: Straight? NO. Orc take bent. Bend it, den talk.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.plain.orc.2: You tink me stupid? Money is bendy! Dis is not!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.plain.goblin.0: Ha! Straight? Dat no coin, dat is a stick wiv ideas above it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.plain.goblin.1: Is not bent, is not money. Everybody knows dat, stupid human.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.plain.goblin.2: Hee! Nice try. Straight ones is rubbish. Bendy ones is gold, nearly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.bent.orc.1: Dat is proper money. Chief like.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.bent.orc.2: Ugh. Fine. Dis go in chief hoard.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.bent.goblin.0: Ooh, bendy! Into da hoard it goes, nobody sees, hee hee.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.bent.goblin.1: Now dat is a proper crooked coin. You got taste, human.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.bent.goblin.2: Bent and shiny! King will say tank you. Maybe. If I tell him.
No trade. You not our kind. Go way.
Stall closed for you. Stand over dere and bleed.
Me no sell to you. Chief say no.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.market.no.gobl: Sell to YOU? Hee! Only friends, and you got none here.
No no no. Stall is for da spared. You is not spared. Yet.
Go way. Put on a mask or make friends, den come back wiv bent coin.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.market.empty.o: Nuffin to sell. Camp is eating it.
Stall empty. Come back when we hunt more.
No goods. No coin. Go away.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.green.market.empty.g: Shelves bare! Da camp ate it all. Come back tomorrow.
Nuffin spare today. Bring me stuff and bent coin instead, hee.
Not a ting to sell. Tell da hunters to hurry up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.rite.refuse: Not for you. Find yourself another cleric.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.farm_family.welcome: Welcome, %s. There's a seat at our table and work in the barn, if you want it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.farm_family.notice: %s? Not our blood, are you. Doesn't matter; you're our hand now, and the barn's your home.
